```{r}
library(dplyr)

df_exon6  <- merged_onerow_per_sample_exon6  %>% mutate(exon = "Exon6")
df_exon9  <- merged_onerow_per_sample_exon9  %>% mutate(exon = "Exon9")
df_exon10 <- merged_onerow_per_sample_exon10 %>% mutate(exon = "Exon10")
df_exon12 <- merged_onerow_per_sample_exon12 %>% mutate(exon = "Exon12")
df_exon15 <- merged_onerow_per_sample_exon15 %>% mutate(exon = "Exon15")
df_exon16 <- merged_onerow_per_sample_exon16 %>% mutate(exon = "Exon16")
df_exon17 <- merged_onerow_per_sample_exon17 %>% mutate(exon = "Exon17")
```


```{r}
df_all_exons <- bind_rows(
  df_exon6,
  df_exon9,
  df_exon10,
  df_exon12,
  df_exon15,
  df_exon16,
  df_exon17
)
```


```{r}
df_all_exons$exon <- factor(
  df_all_exons$exon,
  levels = c(
    "Exon12",
    "Exon6",
    "Exon9",
    "Exon10",
    "Exon15",
    "Exon16",
    "Exon17"
  )
)
```


```{r}
library(glmmTMB)

model_joint_all_exons <- glmmTMB(
  cbind(skipping, total_inclusion) ~
    exon * SMTSD +
    SEX +
    AGE +
    RIN_number +
    (1 | SUBJID),
  family = betabinomial(),
  data = df_all_exons
)
```


```{r}
library(emmeans)
library(dplyr)

# 1. Fit emmeans model (ALL exons, ALL tissues)
emm_all_exons <- emmeans(model_joint_all_exons, ~ exon | SMTSD)
```

```{r}
summary(emm_all_exons, type = "response")
```

```{r}
contr <- contrast(
  emm_all_exons,
  method = list(
    Exon6_vs_Exon12  = c(-1, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0),
    Exon9_vs_Exon12  = c(-1, 0, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0),
    Exon10_vs_Exon12 = c(-1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0, 0),
    Exon15_vs_Exon12 = c(-1, 0, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0),
    Exon16_vs_Exon12 = c(-1, 0, 0, 0, 0, 1, 0),
    Exon17_vs_Exon12 = c(-1, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 1)
  ),
  by = "SMTSD"
)
```

```{r}
contr_sum <- as.data.frame(summary(contr, infer = TRUE)) %>%
  filter(SMTSD == "Breast - Mammary Tissue")
```

```{r}
final_table <- contr_sum %>%
  mutate(
    OR = exp(estimate),
    OR_low = exp(asymp.LCL),
    OR_high = exp(asymp.UCL)
  )
```

```{r}
emm_resp <- emmeans(model_joint_all_exons, ~ exon | SMTSD, type = "response")

breast_probs <- as.data.frame(emm_resp) %>%
  filter(SMTSD == "Breast - Mammary Tissue") %>%
  mutate(exon = tolower(exon)) %>%
  dplyr::select(exon, prob)
```

```{r}
final_table <- final_table %>%
  mutate(
    exon = sub("_vs_Exon12", "", contrast),
    exon = tolower(exon)
  )
```

```{r}
final_table <- final_table %>%
  left_join(breast_probs, by = "exon")
```

```{r}
exon12_prob <- breast_probs %>%
  filter(exon == "exon12") %>%
  pull(prob)
```

```{r}
final_table <- final_table %>%
  mutate(
    fold_vs_exon12 = prob / exon12_prob
  )
```

```{r}
final_table <- final_table %>%
  dplyr::select(
    contrast,
    estimate,
    SE,
    p.value,
    OR,
    OR_low,
    OR_high,
    prob,
    fold_vs_exon12
  ) %>%
  arrange(p.value)

```
```{r}
final_table <- contr_sum %>%
  mutate(
    OR = exp(-estimate),
    OR_low = exp(-asymp.UCL),
    OR_high = exp(-asymp.LCL)
  )
```

```{r}
final_table
```


```{r}
plot_df <- final_table %>%
  mutate(
    exon = gsub("_vs_Exon12", "", contrast),
    label = paste0("Exon12 - ", exon),

    sig = case_when(
      p.value < 0.001 ~ "***",
      p.value < 0.01  ~ "**",
      p.value < 0.05  ~ "*",
      TRUE ~ ""
    ),

    label = paste0(label, " ", sig)
  )

ggplot(plot_df,
       aes(x = OR,
           y = reorder(label, OR))) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_errorbarh(
    aes(xmin = OR_low, xmax = OR_high),
    height = 0.2
  ) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    x = "Odds ratio (Exon12 relative to Exon, in Breast tissue)",
    y = "Exon comparison"
  ) + 
  theme(
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 11),  # tissue labels
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 11))
```

```{r}
plot_df <- breast_probs_plot %>%
  filter(exon != "Exon12") %>%
  mutate(
    percent_change = ((prob / exon12_prob) - 1) * 100,
    lower = ((asymp.LCL / exon12_prob) - 1) * 100,
    upper = ((asymp.UCL / exon12_prob) - 1) * 100
  )
```
```{r}
plot_df <- plot_df %>%
  left_join(
    final_table %>%
      dplyr::select(p.value, prob_exon = prob),
    by = c("prob" = "prob_exon")
  )
```
```{r}

  )
```

```{r}

library(tibble)

effect_matrix <- tribble(
  ~Contrast, ~Exon6, ~Exon9, ~Exon10, ~Exon12, ~Exon15, ~Exon16, ~Exon17,

  "Breast vs colon sigmoid",      -12,   55,   19,  131,   15,   38,   26,
  "Breast vs colon transverse",    19,   124,   32,  165,   35,    3,  -45,
  "Breast vs liver",               17,   309,  303,  540,   67,  -27,  -47,
  "Breast vs ovary",              -46,    24,  -57,   91,  -65,   66,   48,
  "Breast vs pancreas",            39,   763,  223,  497,  200,    8,  -59,
  "Breast vs prostate",           -19,   313,  -29,  187,  -24,   69,  -37,
  "Breast vs small intestine",    -18,    43,    7,   79,   -7,   -4,  -71,
  "Breast vs stomach",              0,   160,   37,  129,   70,   31,  -45,
  "Breast vs uterus",             -19,    15,  -52,  203,  -59,   18,   10,
  "Breast vs whole blood",        -43,   -21,   33,  189,  -77,  -21,  -88
)
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)

# convert to long format
mat_long <- mat %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("Contrast") %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -Contrast,
    names_to = "Exon",
    values_to = "Effect"
  )

# set desired exon order
mat_long$Exon <- factor(
  mat_long$Exon,
  levels = c("Exon6", "Exon9", "Exon10", "Exon12",
             "Exon15", "Exon16", "Exon17")
)

# heatmap
ggplot(mat_long, aes(x = Exon, y = Contrast, fill = Effect)) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "blue",
    mid = "white",
    high = "red",
    midpoint = 0
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    x = "Exon",
    y = "Tissue contrast (vs breast)",
    fill = "Percent difference"
  ) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
  )
```


```{r}
ggplot(mat_long, aes(x = Exon, y = reorder(Contrast, Effect), fill = Effect)) +

  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "blue", mid = "white", high = "red") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = "Exon", y = "Tissue contrast (vs breast)", fill = "% difference")
```

```{r}
  cbind(skipping, total_inclusion) ~ 
    SMTSD + 
    SEX + 
    AGE +
    RIN_number +
    (1 | SUBJID),
  
  family = betabinomial(),
  data = merged_onerow_per_sample_exon12_withoutfemale
)

emm_tmb_mainmodel_exon12_withoutfemale <- emmeans(mainmodel_exon12_withoutfemale, ~ SMTSD)

mainmodel_exon12_withoutfemale
pairs_tmb_mainmodel_exon12_withoutfemale
```
```{r}
emm_exon12_withoutfemale <- emmeans(mainmodel_exon12_withoutfemale, ~ SMTSD)
levels(mainmodel_exon12_withoutfemale$data$SMTSD)
contr_exon12_withoutfemale <- contrast(emm_exon12_withoutfemale, method = "trt.vs.ctrl", ref = "Breast - Mammary Tissue", reverse = TRUE)
summary(contr_exon12_withoutfemale, adjust = "BH")
```
```{r}
summary(emm_exon12_withoutfemale, type = "response")
```
```{r}
pairs_df_withoutfemale <- as.data.frame(summary(contr_exon12_withoutfemale, adjust = "BH"))

pairs_df_withoutfemale <- pairs_df_withoutfemale %>%
  mutate(
    odds_ratio = exp(estimate),
    percent_difference = odds_ratio,

    lower_ci = exp(estimate - 1.96 * SE),
    upper_ci = exp(estimate + 1.96 * SE),

    sig = case_when(
      p.value < 0.001 ~ "***",
      p.value < 0.01  ~ "**",
      p.value < 0.05  ~ "*",
      TRUE ~ ""
    ),

    # extract tissue name (Breast is already reference direction)
    tissue = gsub("Breast - Mammary Tissue - ", "", contrast),
    tissue = paste0(tissue, sig)
  )
pairs_df_withoutfemale <- pairs_df_withoutfemale %>%
  mutate(
    tissue = contrast,

    # remove only "(" and ")" but keep text
    tissue = gsub("[()]", "", tissue),

    tissue = trimws(tissue)
  )
pairs_df_withoutfemale <- pairs_df_withoutfemale %>%
  mutate(
    tissue = gsub("Colon - Sigmoid", "Colon (Sigmoid)", tissue),
    tissue = gsub("Colon - Transverse", "Colon (Transverse)", tissue),
    tissue = gsub("Small Intestine - Terminal Ileum", "Small intestine", tissue),

    # optional simplifications
    tissue = gsub("Whole Blood", "Blood", tissue),
    tissue = gsub("Breast - Mammary Tissue", "Breast", tissue)
  )
pairs_df_withoutfemale <- pairs_df_withoutfemale %>%
  mutate(
    tissue = paste0(tissue, sig)
  )
    
ggplot(pairs_df_withoutfemale,
       aes(x = odds_ratio,
           y = reorder(tissue, odds_ratio))) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_errorbarh(
    aes(xmin = lower_ci, xmax = upper_ci),
    height = 0.2
  ) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = c(1, 3, 5, 7, 9, 11, 13)
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 11),  # tissue labels
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 11)   # x-axis labels (optional)
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Odds ratio (Breast relative to tissue, without female breast samples)",
    y = "Tissue comparison"
  )
```

```{r}
emm_thisplot_mainmodel_exon12_df_withoutfemale <- as.data.frame(emm_thisplot_mainmodel_exon12_withoutfemale)
breast_prob_mainmodel_exon12_withoutfemale <- emm_thisplot_mainmodel_exon12_df_withoutfemale$prob[emm_thisplot_mainmodel_exon12_df_withoutfemale$SMTSD == "Breast - Mammary Tissue"]
```

```{r}
pairs_df_withoutfemale_exon9 <- as.data.frame(summary(contr_exon9_withoutfemale, adjust = "BH"))

pairs_df_withoutfemale_exon9 <- pairs_df_withoutfemale_exon9 %>%
  mutate(
    odds_ratio = exp(estimate),
    percent_difference = odds_ratio,

    lower_ci = exp(estimate - 1.96 * SE),
    upper_ci = exp(estimate + 1.96 * SE),

    sig = case_when(
      p.value < 0.001 ~ "***",
      p.value < 0.01  ~ "**",
      p.value < 0.05  ~ "*",
      TRUE ~ ""
    ),

    # extract tissue name (Breast is already reference direction)
    tissue = gsub("Breast - Mammary Tissue - ", "", contrast),
    tissue = paste0(tissue, sig)
  )
pairs_df_withoutfemale_exon9 <- pairs_df_withoutfemale_exon9 %>%
  mutate(
    tissue = contrast,

    # remove only "(" and ")" but keep text
    tissue = gsub("[()]", "", tissue),

    tissue = trimws(tissue)
  )
pairs_df_withoutfemale_exon9 <- pairs_df_withoutfemale_exon9 %>%
  mutate(
    tissue = gsub("Colon - Sigmoid", "Colon (Sigmoid)", tissue),
    tissue = gsub("Colon - Transverse", "Colon (Transverse)", tissue),
    tissue = gsub("Small Intestine - Terminal Ileum", "Small intestine", tissue),

    # optional simplifications
    tissue = gsub("Whole Blood", "Blood", tissue),
    tissue = gsub("Breast - Mammary Tissue", "Breast", tissue)
  )
pairs_df_withoutfemale_exon9 <- pairs_df_withoutfemale_exon9 %>%
  mutate(
    tissue = paste0(tissue, sig)
  )
    
ggplot(pairs_df_withoutfemale_exon9,
       aes(x = odds_ratio,
           y = reorder(tissue, odds_ratio))) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_errorbarh(
    aes(xmin = lower_ci, xmax = upper_ci),
    height = 0.2
  ) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = c(1, 3, 5, 7, 9, 11, 13)
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 11),  # tissue labels
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 11)   # x-axis labels (optional)
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Odds ratio (Breast relative to tissue, without female breast samples)",
    y = "Tissue comparison"
  )
```
